NOON REPORT - MV TORMAR SPRING

Next port: Sept-Iles
ETA Sept-Iles: 2025-01-30 2100 UTC
ETA based on: 12.5 kn
Remarks: Wind and sea increasing from W in the afternoon.

Master MV TORMAR SPRING
